selection.test_crowd_rule: Exclude whole candidate photo if any of12 target categories has crowd annotations.
selection.positive_stratum: At least one noncrowd target box min edge16px and area>=1%; score against all boxes including smaller incidental objects.
selection.reference_crop: Same one v17 boxed support per target; floor/ceil clipped crop; no query annotation is supplied to models.

protocol.primary: Macro top1 localized recall at IoU>=.5, with one global cutoff from all valid DEV absent pairs.
protocol.bootstrap: 5000 paired photo-cluster draws; fixed supports and DEV thresholds.

limitations: Fresh means absent from prior HyperNet photo iterations, not unseen by the pretrained OWL checkpoint.
COCO is named in OWL training; no absence of pretraining overlap or novel category status is established.
One boxed support per category is additional annotation; 288 labeled DEV photos are supervision beyond the support.
COCO absence means no supplied annotation; missing labels and physical-instance duplicates may remain.
Selected source strata are not natural prevalence. False alarms per10000 are normalized rates, not certification of rare-event operation.
Top1 localized recall is a custom metric, not the published COCO AP metric.
V17 fresh TEST photos are now excluded from this new cohort, along with every earlier COCO source ID.
V18 used only48 of the already-known288 DEV photos; its exploratory thresholds are not reused.
